description: This file defines the core service class 'ConciergeService' for the Eclipse Ditto platform. It sets up and initializes the service, manages configuration, and creates the main actor for the Concierge service.

classes.name: ConciergeService
classes.description: Main service class for Eclipse Ditto's Concierge feature, responsible for startup and actor creation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the service, creates and starts the ConciergeService instance.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Provides the configuration specific to the Concierge service.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Creates properties for the main root actor of the service.
